description: This Java class 'EnableProfileActivity' extends FragmentActivity to enable a device profile after device provisioning. It interacts with Android's DevicePolicyManager to set profile name and enable the profile, then navigates to the MainActivity.

classes.name: EnableProfileActivity
classes.description: An activity that, upon creation, sets up a device profile using DevicePolicyManager and then starts the MainActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, enabling the device profile if first created, then transitions to MainActivity.
